task_definition.task_description: Please check whether flight CA1234 is on time, then book it for John Doe in economy. After that, reserve 2 of the best available recommendation in electronics for user_001, build the checkout from that reservation, and then send me a high-priority app alert with the flight status, the booking confirmation code, and the note that a substitute item has been reserved and checkout is ready.

user_input.query: Please check whether flight CA1234 is on time, and if it is, book it for John Doe in economy. Then, for user_001, reserve 2 of the best available recommendation in electronics—please note I’m looking at product_id p_sony_xm5_blk—then build the checkout from that reservation. After that, send me a high-priority app alert with the flight status, the booking confirmation code, and a note that a substitute item has been reserved and the checkout is ready.
